goal: Allow non-standard scripts into testnet mempools when acceptnonstdtxn is enabled
Lets developers test experimental transactions and soft forks without having to mine them directly
reviewability: Author has open reviewer questions and test suggestions to address
agreement: Contested objection that changing acceptnonstdtxn exceeds expected Knots behavior (luke-jr)
Verified by testing bip448 branch with compiler enforcement of consensus script flags (instagibbs)
Support for compile-time script checks and mempool validation changes (fjahr, ismaelsadeeq, sedited)
Open suggestions on test coverage, logging, and release note phrasing (instagibbs, ismaelsadeeq)

categories.name: mempool
why: P3 because it lets testnet mempools accept experimental scripts without mining them into blocks
Benefit is confined to test networks and developers experimenting with soft forks or new opcodes
